test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: "People who regularly exercise are less likely to fall ill."

Conclusions:

I. Regular exercise improves immunity.

II. Illness is directly linked to lack of physical activity.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given Statement: "People who regularly exercise are less likely to fall ill."

Conclusion:

I. Regular exercise improves immunity. → True</span&g
